question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?

-- Let me verify these numbers manually:
-- 531 (Pallet of L) -> 521 x12, 521 -> 502 x72, so 502 = 12*72 = 864 ✓
-- 532 (Pallet of M) -> 522 x20, 522 -> 501 x36, so 501 = 20*36 = 720 ✓
-- 533 (Pallet Mix MS) -> 522 x10, 523 x20
--   522 -> 501 x36, so 501 = 10*36 = 360
--   523 -> 502 x30, so 502 = 20*30 = 600
--   Total = 360 + 600 = 960 ✓
-- 534 (Pallet Mix SG) -> 523 x20, 524 x16
--   523 -> 502 x30, so 502 = 20*30 = 600
--   524 -> 511 x8, so 511 = 16*8 = 128
--   511 -> 501 x3, 502 x2
--   501 = 128*3 = 384
--   502 = 128*2 = 256
--   Total = 600 + 384 + 256 = 1240 ✓

-- Now compute the average across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
  SELECT 
    r.id AS root_id,
    p.id AS current_id,
    p.name AS current_name,
    1 AS qty,
    CASE WHEN p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_leaf
  FROM packaging p
  JOIN (
    SELECT id FROM packaging
    EXCEPT
    SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
  ) r ON p.id = r.id
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    pt.root_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    cp.name,
    pt.qty * pr.qty,
    CASE WHEN cp.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  FROM packaging_tree pt
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
  JOIN packaging cp ON cp.id = pr.contains_id
),
root_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    root_id,
    SUM(qty) AS total_leaf_quantity
  FROM packaging_tree
  WHERE is_leaf = 1
  GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_quantity) AS average_total_quantity
FROM root_totals
